facts.business: Meenakshi Steel Industries Limited is engaged in the business of granting loans.

auditor.name: V R S K & Co. LLP

key_risks: Financial Risk: instability and losses in the financial market caused by movements in stock prices, currencies, interest rates
Liquidity Risk: risk that the Company will be unable to meet its financial commitment to a Bank/Financial Institution
Credit Risk: risk of loss of principal or loss of a financial reward stemming from a borrower's failure to repay a loan or otherwise meet a contractual obligation
Time Risk: to compensate for non-receipt of expected inflow of funds
facts.related_party_note: During the year under review, the Company had not entered into any transactions as enumerated in section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 and rules made thereunder with the related party as defined under section 2(76) of the Act.
